title: What the Well Kept

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The runner carries what she will not read, and the yard keeps what no slate will take; both go home with the weight of it and neither calls it an account.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the women at the yard well in Low Kiln, told on a morning of Frost

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and eighty-two to two hundred and eighty-four days, six months and one hundred and two to one hundred and four days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing — the body inventoried as a wound of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold at cheek, temple and wrist and an afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; the six hearings of the full note kept beside and never among with no seventh; the told bell kept beside the heard; the told figure kept beside the paid; the held interval and the empty interval kept as objects on the sixth place; the small coordinations of the hand entered on that place and never promoted into a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a doctrine or a rule — with no present-tense Chicago break and no tagged remembered line; the old life stays offstage and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no sixth hearing, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, no sixth asking and no witness for the row question (the five askings and one further shaping stand as they stood), no tenth record-first hand and no eighth of the green or ninth of the shape, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause, no private record opened, read or copied, and no ending. Frost 13–15 are ordinary tending days with no market, Cross or bell. Frost 20 (Day 289), the second Account-day, stands five mornings beyond the close and is not brought early.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Thirteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and the first \daymark{282}{Frost 13, Thirdday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary working day with no market, Cross or bell. Open in the small hours with the hand laid down against the fold on the one hundred and thirty-eighth answer as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; never recalled as growth, a gift, a reaching or a sign. No recap of Chapter 76; the reader has just read it. Carry 281 to 282 exact, six months and one hundred and two days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and eighty-two days, its payer unnamed (T088). Body inventory in the old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, gone past the point where a child would eat it, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread and a basket set down is a pot set down and left; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform. He knows the composed face that is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse, and that a man must be warmed from the outside and slowly; he wants the crust lifted two inches and cannot close two inches on the pot handle, both true and the second louder, entered nowhere (T060/T086). Three counts in three places: the carried fire's four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should stand under the floor, the river's water over water at the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands (T088, T061/T082). Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among, five from four sources and the sixth, the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go and never with the things that came from vessels; the seventh place stays empty and is not filled to make a row come out even. The heard bell's four, four and a gap stays in the square beside the told bell of the Long Night, not folded into the three and not a seventh of the full note (T078). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it was the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, touches the widow's mark at no morning and at no basket because neither is an opening, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, glances once at the clay jar cold under its lead glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and gives no instruction at any hour to the basket; the boy is set under the roof and never in the Debt Loft (T058/T079, T100). The stayed frost lies white on the well's north lip and the plate of ice stands on its flat stone out of the path of feet, weather entered nowhere and no figure, sign, lesson, cause, mending or payer made of either (T083/T085 held, not paid). The dressed grain lies covered and unfigured under wool at the rack end; Frost's first arithmetic stays locked up the clay road in Berr's box with the printed one in twelve unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid, and nothing from the reading is brought back under the roof as lesson, figure, mending or payment (T077, T015/T041/T047). Frost 13 comes on in its own morning and was not brought into Day 281; Frost 20 (Day 289) stands five mornings ahead and is not brought early. **Answer 139:** the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes the small intake of the river's own going, carries it across the little silence left by one of the counted breaths in the next room and comes down on the next low note — one house rhythm carried across the river's interval on an ordinary morning, no house count borrowed and no fifth supplied (T061/T082). Kept as an honest coordination on the sixth place, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; not a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a doctrine or a rule.

scenes.title: The Things Not Entered
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 282, no new dated heading: afternoon at the Clay Yard, the yard well and skinned trough, the drying racks and rack end, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and the back room as a direction and a sound, into the small hours at the bed and the towel. Afternoon thins without ending the way heat goes out of a pot set off the coals and left upon a cold stone; heat draws back from the fold and sits behind the pot; inventory renewed in the old order, exact and unentered (T060/T086, T061/T082). Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey hairline beside it called the thaw, unswept both; the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lie; the round ring where the shallow pan once stood with no scrape or crumb; the trough skinned over and its water called weather; the field's empty place out on the worked strips; and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out. Seven are seven and not an account; the missing hand carried, not named, not paid and not joined to the shelf's two gaps, the fold's one crust or the dressed grain (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). The stayed frost lies on the well lip past the going of the light and the plate of ice stands where it was set, clouded where the silt rose into it, weather entered nowhere and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held, not paid). Garl stays in objects and not in a story: the salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease on its peg behind the door, the wheel-seat keeping its twenty-year lean and its hollow that nobody fills, the clean dark line with its finer grey beside it, the debt against a firing of tiles neither paid nor settled nor done with and worse for being uncalled, and the proverb gone to the pot and the fire and never to a person; his name unspoken two hundred and eighty-two days and no collector up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). At the kindling Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the very lip of the sill where it cannot, beside Garl's unforged collector sentence with no name on the man who turned back at the frozen ford and no figure on the debt; he tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, says Yes, house to those who want the thaw early and those who want it late and keeps the late because it puts off the paying though the paying stands in the ruts; brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name — a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven; draws the breath that should have gone in at the top of the reach and does not spend it, chest tight, Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line and no scrubbing lifting it, the pale clip-ring at the left wrist holding what light there is and giving it back, his stroke over the shallow bright patch without the half-check; up in the Debt Loft, a sound with a direction and never a room he is taken into, the warm stone in its unmarked pot is cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness (T036/T076, T006). At the shed edge Jorra comes through with the day's meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and under the nails, not bone-coloured slip; he keeps dusty forearms and clean ones on one tray and parts them as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, asking neither which slate broke nor whether it was a birth-slate; speaks to the wheel before any person (It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady) and tells a pot You'll do in a voice with no welcome and no unkindness; knows the full note that pot will give three turns before it leaves his hands, with air under it and a want in it, and withholds the knowing on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them; puts his bent finger into the cold iron of the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and leaves the tongue standing so the end of her instruction arrives at the pot, the boy reading one iron with two bites — the holding and the taking — with no Grathic word for both mercies (T035/T031/T062). The back room keeps its finger's width of open and its sound of low voices; men unnamed go low into it before first grey and neither Jorra nor Sella gives the house a name for them and nobody says the room was cold. The burned-slate word stands at four from Slate Row, a direction over the boards and not a fifth telling; the two tellings of the counting room shut in the war stand at two and have not become three; three pot sayings stand with the premature Smoke 14 note on a place apart and no fourth likeness made a cause. The ownerless question stands at five askings with one shaping, a finger between every pair, no witness under any and no row named — no sixth asking and no further shaping on this day, the silence a keeping and not a witness (T101, T065/T095). At the going of the light Sella sets him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen, tells the fire it was the thaw, keeps her finger above the charcoal and her lips on the two-gapped row, and gives no instruction to the basket (T058/T079, T100). **Answer 140:** the hand takes the small intake of one counted breath from the room whose floor does not touch his and the hold of the next, sets them side by side with a finger between, leaves the letting-go between them where it was, and comes down on the river's next low note — two intakes held apart as objects on the sixth place, neither made to agree with the fire's missing fifth (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Fourth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated \daymark{283}{Frost 14, Fourthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the morning. New day, new date, no recap. Frost 14 comes on its own morning and was not brought into Day 282; there is no market, Cross or bell on a Fourthday; Frost 20 (Day 289), the second Account-day, four mornings ahead and not brought into a day that has not earned it, and the first reading not looked at again as a sign, lesson, mending or payment. Carry 282 to 283 exact, six months and one hundred and three days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and eighty-three days, its payer unnamed (T088). First smells and sounds as before: hot clay cooled under tallow, wet wool, the sour breath of the unswept corner called the thaw, the river low over lower under the finger's-width door, the kiln answering in fours with its gap and not a bell (T088, T061/T082). Body inventory renewed in the old order — one crust two inches off with its unnamed gap and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; the surgeon's knowledge that a cold patient cannot clot is exact and buys nothing (T060/T086). Three counts in three places with no agreement among them, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place kept empty and not filled; the heard bell's four, four and a gap kept beside the told bell in the square and not folded into the three (T088, T061/T082, T078). Sella's grammar holds exactly: fire before basket, instruction to the fire, the wool, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket, The house will keep it, half-pace from every open slate, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, fold righted without a look at his face, finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, and the widow's mark untouched at a morning, a hearth and a basket, because none is an opening and the hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour (T058/T079, T100). The dressed grain is turned once beneath the wool for damp with a lighter touch and given no figure; read over on Frost 10 by a number that did not know what it cost, the space between figure and price still unsigned (T077). Frost's first arithmetic stays locked in Berr's box up the clay road, the printed one in twelve unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid (T015/T041/T047). The stayed frost, the skinned trough and the plate of ice stand where the yard left them, called weather and entered nowhere (T083/T085 held, not paid). Seven walked-around places gone around with a look and a wide step and no number; Garl in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and eighty-three days, no collector up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Held counts kept exact and unadvanced: five askings with one shaping and no witness; nine stoppings with no tenth; nine record-first hands with Ilva's ninth unread; six hearings with no seventh; seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth; no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause (T101, T036/T076, T080, T061/T082, T050/T051, T033/T034, T060/T086). **Answer 141:** the hand takes the small intake of a count from the next room, holds it past that count's letting-go and through the little silence after it, and comes down on the river's next low note, the little silence left whole and empty and not filled to make a row come out even (T061/T082).

scenes.title: A Direction Arrived Nowhere
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: afternoon of Day 283 at the yard well and drying racks, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and the back room as a direction and a sound, into the small hours at the bed and the towel. Afternoon thins without ending; inventory renewed, exact and unentered (T061/T082, T060/T086). **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, PLANTED AND NOT PAID (T080, advanced and not paid):** at the yard well Ilva is glimpsed once drawing water with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey dust of the drying racks worked into the seam of one thumb, which she does not scrub out. Asked what the month's firings have taken, her hand goes toward her sleeve and stays there; the short strip of notched birch is not taken out, read, asked about, taken a figure from or joined to the charcoal under the shelf, the cord, the knots, the pages, the tins, the missing hand or the pale line. Her eyes go to the asker and her mouth answers the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. She goes on with her water and nobody turns twice. The boy files no tenth record-first hand; the ninth stays nine with a finger between it and the eighth, the count stays in wood where no slate can take a figure off it, and she does not know she was read (T080 held at nine, not paid). Then an unnamed woman at the well, speaking to the boards and the well-roof and not into the basket, mentions as a direction arrived nowhere that the runner who carries Berr Clay's slate once carried a figure that named a person she knew — no owner of the voice, no room, no hand at a slate, no name for the person, no figure spoken, no confession and no cause. The boy takes the saying apart as he takes a wound apart and files it on a place of its own beside Hessa Rale's eighth record-first hand with a finger between: a shaping toward the far-off day she must choose whether to read what she has carried for years, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a tenth hand, not a cause, not a confession, not a joining, not a witness and not paid; he does not make the runner a reader, does not join the saying to Ilva's strip in the sleeve a pace away, and does not let one stray saying stand up as a rule (T080, T015/T041/T047). The shallow bright patch on the flagstones is kept as it has been since Seed 22 and the broom stroke goes over it without the half-check, the stones still keeping the place where it stopped; the loft scrape lies on a place of its own and the carried man's pale line on another, neither laid across the other (T036/T076). Tarn at the kindling keeps six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged sentence, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, agrees with early and late and keeps the late, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name — a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven — draws the breath he does not spend, chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, pale clip-ring at the wrist, stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying (T036/T076, T006). Jorra's meal-fine grey dust, dusty forearms parted from clean, speech to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld knowledge of the pot's note, bent finger standing in the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and the double bite of the iron filed as an object joined to no kiln all stand as they stood; men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey and were given no name; burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, he's not Vail sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064). No sixth asking comes over the boards and no further shaping; the silence is a keeping and not a sixth witness. At the going of the light Sella carries him up at the half-pace, sets him on the bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen, and gives no instruction to the basket (T058/T079). **Answer 142:** the hand takes two intakes from the room whose floor does not touch apart with a finger between and bridges them over the river's note, the bridge laid down as an object on the sixth place and not a span crossed, no house count borrowed for it and the saying at the well left where it was said (T061/T082, T080).

scenes.title: The Last Tending Day
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated \daymark{284}{Frost 15, Fifthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the morning. New day, new date, no recap. Frost 15 comes on its own morning and was not brought into Day 283; no market, Cross or bell on a Fifthday; Frost 20 (Day 289), the second Account-day, three mornings ahead and not brought into a day that has not earned it. Carry 283 to 284 exact, six months and one hundred and four days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and eighty-four days, its payer unnamed (T088). He comes into the morning two hundred and eighty-four days old, six months and one hundred and four days, told by nobody, the number exact and complete against a house that keeps its days in loaves, glances and unnamed spaces (T071/T072). Body inventory in the old order: one leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its unnamed gap and no third, thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; the composed face that is not composure, the cold patient who will seem better before he is worse; he wants the crust lifted and cannot close two inches on the pot handle, both true and the second louder (T060/T086). Three counts in three places with no agreement among them, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place kept empty; the heard bell's four, four and a gap stays in the square beside the told bell and is not folded into the three or made a seventh of the full note (T088, T061/T082, T078). Sella's grammar holds exactly: fire before basket, instruction to tools never the basket, The house will keep it, half-pace from every open slate, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, fold righted without a look, thread left frozen, finger on top of the shelf's edge so the charcoal stays unread, lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, one glance at the clay jar under its lead glaze and the hand shut half over nothing; the widow's mark untouched at a morning, a hearth and a rack, because none is an opening (T058/T079, T100). The dressed grain is turned once under wool for damp with a progressively lighter touch and given no figure; the arithmetic that read over it on Frost 10 did not know what it cost and the space between figure and price has no signature (T077). Frost's first arithmetic stays locked in Berr's box up the clay road, the printed one in twelve unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid; the reading is not looked at again as a sign, lesson, mending or payment (T015/T041/T047). Seven walked-around places gone around with a look and a wide step and no number; the staying frost called weather and the plate of ice standing where it was set, both entered nowhere (T083/T085 held, T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Garl in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and eighty-four days, the tile debt worse for being uncalled; no collector up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). The Frost 14 well-saying is held on a place of its own beside Hessa's eighth hand with a finger between — one saying, no second shaping on this day, no witness, no confession, no joining and no witness stood anywhere to be asked; the held interval and the empty interval stay objects on the sixth place and neither one of them nor the saying is made to stand up as a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stands (T080, T061/T082). Keep the other held counts exact: five askings with one shaping and no witness; nine stoppings with no tenth; nine hands with Ilva's ninth unread; six hearings with no seventh; seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth; no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause (T101, T036/T076, T080, T061/T082, T050/T051, T033/T034, T060/T086). **Answer 143:** the hand takes the small intake of the river's own going and lets it go on the same note without holding, and comes down — a letting-go kept whole, not an ending made early, not a freedom and not a gift, for a freedom wants a taker and nobody under this roof has taken anything (T061/T082).

scenes.title: Every Tray Parted
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 284, Frost 15, afternoon into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and the back room as a direction and a sound, the bed, the boards and the towel. Frost goes out without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming the months is set right or left wrong in so many words; no lesson made of Frost's first reading and none made now; the next opening stands in the first firing of a later month, far off, not hoped for and not counted toward (T058/T079). Afternoon thins without ending; heat draws back from the fold; inventory renewed, exact and unentered (T061/T082, T060/T086). Stayed frost lies on the well lip past the going of the light and the yard calls it weather still, entered nowhere; the broken plate of ice stands where it was set on its flat stone out of the path of feet, clouded where the silt rose into it (T083/T085 held, **not paid**). Sella carries up at the going of the light at the half-pace from every open slate, sets him on the bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen where it lay, tells the fire it was the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along a row standing with two gaps and gives neither gap a figure, glances once at the clay jar standing cold under its lead glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and gives no instruction at any hour to the basket; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs at a going of the light, because a going of the light is not an opening (T058/T079, T100). At the kindling Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name, a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, draws the breath he does not spend, his chest tight, Ash worked into the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holding what light there is; the loft stone is cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness (T036/T076, T006). Jorra's meal-fine grey dust, withheld knowledge of the pot's note, bent finger leading at the cold damper, back room given no name, burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, he's not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven all stand as they stood (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064). In the small hours the file is turned out on the towel as instruments are turned out for a man who will never be called to use them, each thing in its own place with room between, known by weight before the eye fell on it, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air. Walk the inventory in order: six hearings with no seventh and the empty seventh place kept empty (T061/T082); the heard bell beside the told, four, four and a gap, not folded into the three and not a seventh (T078); the three pot sayings together on their own tray and the premature Smoke 14 note on a place apart, no fourth likeness and no cause; burned slate at four from Slate Row, a direction over the boards and not a fifth telling; the two shut-room tellings at two; the ownerless question on a seventh place with five askings and one shaping, a finger between every pair, no witness under any and no row named (T101); the nine stoppings with no tenth (T036/T076); the nine record-first hands with Ilva's ninth in her sleeve unread and no tenth (T080); the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth (T050/T051, T033/T034); Frost's first arithmetic locked in Berr's box up the clay road with the printed one in twelve unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid, and the dressed grain covered and unfigured under wool with the arithmetic that read over it on Frost 10 still not knowing what it cost, the space between figure and price unsigned (T015/T041/T047, T077). Set the Frost 14 well-saying on a place of its own beside Hessa's eighth hand with a finger between, one saying and no second shaping, not a cause, not a confession, not a joining, not a witness and not paid, and forbid it to stand up with the three held changes, the loft scrape, the carried man's pale line or the boy's own held inch into a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stands (T080, T061/T082). Set the small dry scrape of the loft sill on a place of its own and the carried man's pale line on another, not laid across either; keep Garl in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and eighty-four days and the tile debt worse for being uncalled; keep the stayed frost, the plate of ice, the turned grain and the week's small movements each where they were laid, with no fourth likeness standing up and no doctrine made of three (T009/T013/T092, T083/T085, T061/T082). The finding that a house keeps by not-doings stays on its own place with the boy's own gaps on another and a finger between — the two gaps above the shelf, the one crust in the fold and its unnamed empty place, the pan's gone ring, the field's empty place and the returning-line place where a hand went in and did not come out — no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause (T060/T086, T097 held, T098 carried). **Answer 144:** the hand takes the held interval and the empty interval from the file, sets them side by side with a finger between, and comes down on the river's next low note, neither promoted into a reach, a hearing, a gift, a keeping, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a doctrine or a rule; one hundred and forty-four filed beside one hundred and forty-three, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, and he makes nothing of it and will not let it stand up as a gift, because a gift wants a taker and nobody under this roof has taken anything. The hand lays back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. **284 exact**, six months and one hundred and four days told by nobody; fire's fifth unpaid the same number of days with payer unnamed (T071/T072, T088). Nothing opened, named, called, paid or ended; file open on the towel with every gap left gap, every tray parted by a finger's width, nothing that had moved. Beyond the finger's-width door the frost lies white on the well lip, called weather and entered nowhere, and Frost 20 (Day 289), the month's second Account-day, stands five mornings ahead and is not brought into this day. The river's low note goes quiet after the hand comes down.
